reuse.why: Threads the flag through the existing assertBankAccountIsNotLinked helper and reuses assertAccountIsOpenForBankLinking, but re-writes the unlink field reset instead of extracting it from unlinkAccount.

duplication.why: The db.updateAccount block clearing account_id/bank/balances/sync source is a verbatim copy of the local part of unlinkAccount, and the closed-destination check is run a second time by design.

placement.why: A state mutation (unlinking the previous owner) is hidden inside a function named assert...IsNotLinked, before the link itself runs, rather than in the link flow or a named unlink helper.

scope.why: Changes are limited to the link parameter type, the assertion helper, its six wrappers, the six handlers and tests.

maintainability.why: Works through the existing choke point, but a side-effecting 'assert' and a copied unlink reset will drift from unlinkAccount if the cleared fields change.

bypasses_abstraction.where: accounts/app.ts assertBankAccountIsNotLinked writes the unlink field reset directly instead of sharing the local-unlink step of unlinkAccount.

disguised_duplication.where: The copied unlink update is verbatim, not disguised.
